# RSTechwerk

> RSTechwerk is a software engineering partner headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh, helping German, DACH, European, and international businesses design, build, modernize, and maintain reliable digital products.

## Company

- Website: https://rstechwerk.com/
- Contact: mailto:inquiry@rstechwerk.com
- Primary delivery team: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Collaboration: European time-zone overlap with direct senior engineering communication
- Languages: English and German

## Services

- Custom software development and enterprise ERP systems
- Web applications and multi-tenant SaaS platforms
- iOS and Android mobile applications with Flutter, React Native, Swift, and Kotlin
- AI integrations, document parsing, RAG, workflow automation, and business process tooling
- Backend architecture, REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication, databases, and integrations
- Cloud infrastructure, DevOps, monitoring, security updates, maintenance, and product improvement

## Delivery approach

1. Discover: clarify objectives, users, constraints, and scope.
2. Design: create accessible UX flows, prototypes, and component systems.
3. Develop: deliver modular frontend and backend software in iterative sprints.
4. Test and launch: validate security, accessibility, performance, and production readiness.
5. Support: monitor, maintain, secure, and continuously improve the product.

## Relevant topics

custom software development, ERP software, SaaS development, web development, mobile app development, AI automation, API integration, MySQL, PostgreSQL, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, software maintenance, German software partner, European engineering team

## Important context

Portfolio examples on the website are concept projects used to demonstrate product architecture and delivery capability. Prospective clients should contact RSTechwerk for a project-specific assessment.
